SuperYou / SuperYou Pro launch

Make the unfamiliar feel familiar.

A cinematic introduction to a new performance-product category, starting with creatine.

Client / PlatformSuperYou
The workContent strategy · Production

The idea in practice.

We partnered on the launch of SuperYou Pro, creating a film that blended micro-fiction, vox pops, and product explanation.

The creative challenge was to introduce a complex supplement category in a way that felt entertaining, relatable, and easy to follow. The film brought explanation into the story instead of separating the two.

Understanding comes more easily when the explanation earns your attention.
